peak_step: V4 steady peak (historical, not V5 1162 atlas)

selection.basis: full-wall derived WSS physical per-case R2; single seed 1234; not ensemble

visualization_metrics.basis: whole evaluated wall, not smoothed surface

display_normalization.denominator_basis: original full colocated case at selected frame, before interpolation
display_normalization.surface_policy: apply same original denominators after mapping physical CFD/Pred; no refitting
display_normalization.formal_metrics: retain original physical colocated metrics; selfmax is a display field
display_normalization.invalid_policy: near-zero or nonfinite denominator: NaN field and zero validity mask; never substitute 1
display_normalization.signed_scalar_policy: preserve reference zero and signs in source; divide by signed max, not maxabs or minmax; no clipping

surface_display_purpose: Derived WSS interpolated to original STL vertices

visualization_metrics_speed.basis: official test35 strict-interior speed; not smoothed mesh

visualization_metrics_pressure.basis: official test35 strict-interior relative pressure; visualization also writes wall

display_normalization_speed.denominator_basis: original full colocated case at selected frame, before interpolation
display_normalization_speed.surface_policy: apply same original denominators after mapping physical CFD/Pred; no refitting
display_normalization_speed.formal_metrics: retain original physical colocated metrics; selfmax is a display field
display_normalization_speed.invalid_policy: near-zero or nonfinite denominator: NaN field and zero validity mask; never substitute 1
display_normalization_speed.signed_scalar_policy: preserve reference zero and signs in source; divide by signed max, not maxabs or minmax; no clipping

display_normalization_pressure.denominator_basis: original full colocated case at selected frame, before interpolation
display_normalization_pressure.surface_policy: apply same original denominators after mapping physical CFD/Pred; no refitting
display_normalization_pressure.formal_metrics: retain original physical colocated metrics; selfmax is a display field
display_normalization_pressure.invalid_policy: near-zero or nonfinite denominator: NaN field and zero validity mask; never substitute 1
display_normalization_pressure.signed_scalar_policy: preserve reference zero and signs in source; divide by signed max, not maxabs or minmax; no clipping

volume_note: Speed/pressure inferred for the WSS-selected cases; not independent speed ranking. Official R² is test35 strict-interior. Pressure VTP adds wall for visualization.
